title: 距离相等的条形码
summary: 重排条形码数组，使任意相邻两个值不同，题目保证存在解。
insight: 最大堆每次取频次最高且不等于上一位置的值；把上一轮暂存的值在放置新值后重新入堆，避免连续相同。
pitfalls: 只有在放置另一值后才归还暂存项
答案可为任一合法排列

solutions.title: 最大频次堆与一步冷却
solutions.idea: 用暂存上一值保证相邻不同。
steps: 统计频次并把 [count,value] 放入最大堆，同频按值小优先固定输出
previous 初始化空；每轮弹堆顶写答案并 count--
把旧 previous 若剩余放回堆，再令 current 为新 previous；返回数组

code.java: class Solution { public int[] rearrangeBarcodes(int[] barcodes){Map<Integer,Integer> count=new HashMap<>();for(int value:barcodes)count.merge(value,1,Integer::sum);PriorityQueue<int[]> heap=new PriorityQueue<>((a,b)->a[0]!=b[0]?b[0]-a[0]:a[1]-b[1]);for(Map.Entry<Integer,Integer> entry:count.entrySet())heap.offer(new int[]{entry.getValue(),entry.getKey()});int[] answer=new int[barcodes.length],previous=null;for(int i=0;i<answer.length;i++){int[] current=heap.poll();answer[i]=current[1];current[0]--;if(previous!=null&&previous[0]>0)heap.offer(previous);previous=current;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun rearrangeBarcodes(barcodes:IntArray):IntArray{val count=barcodes.toList().groupingBy{it}.eachCount();val heap=java.util.PriorityQueue<IntArray>{a,b->if(a[0]!=b[0])b[0]-a[0] else a[1]-b[1]};for((value,frequency) in count)heap.add(intArrayOf(frequency,value));val answer=IntArray(barcodes.size);var previous:IntArray?=null;for(i in answer.indices){val current=heap.remove();answer[i]=current[1];current[0]--;if(previous!=null&&previous[0]>0)heap.add(previous);previous=current};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> rearrangeBarcodes(vector<int>& barcodes){unordered_map<int,int> count;for(int value:barcodes)++count[value];priority_queue<pair<int,int>> heap;for(auto [value,frequency]:count)heap.push({frequency,-value});vector<int> answer;pair<int,int> previous{0,0};while(!heap.empty()){auto current=heap.top();heap.pop();answer.push_back(-current.second);--current.first;if(previous.first)heap.push(previous);previous=current;}return answer;} };
